data.title: Crypto Token Rug Pull Early Warning — On-Chain and OSINT Indicators
data.description: Detects cryptocurrency rug pull / exit scam indicators using on-chain and OSINT signals. Rug pulls constituted 68% of all crypto scams in 2025 (350+ cases 2024). On-chain indicators: Uniswap liquidity removal >80% in single transaction, token holder concentration (top 5 holders >60%), contract functions with hidden mint/pause/ blacklist capabilities. OSINT indicators: social media silence after promotion burst, developer wallet activity cessation, Telegram/Discord channel deletion. Critical finding: OSINT signals precede on-chain anomalies by days or weeks.

detection.condition: liquidity_removal_pct > 80 in single tx OR top5_holder_concentration > 0.60 OR contract_has_hidden_functions == true

queries.python:
# Rug Pull Early Warning — Multi-signal Detection Pipeline

# On-chain signals (via blockchain node or analytics API)
def check_onchain_signals(token_address):
    signals = {}

    # 1. Liquidity concentration
    pool = get_uniswap_pool(token_address)
    top5_pct = sum(get_top_holders(token_address, n=5)) / total_supply
    signals['holder_concentration'] = top5_pct > 0.60

    # 2. Contract risk analysis (EVM bytecode heuristics)
    bytecode = get_contract_bytecode(token_address)
    signals['hidden_mint'] = has_mint_function(bytecode)
    signals['hidden_pause'] = has_pause_function(bytecode)
    signals['hidden_blacklist'] = has_blacklist_function(bytecode)
    signals['no_renounced_ownership'] = not ownership_renounced(token_address)

    # 3. Liquidity lock status
    signals['liquidity_unlocked'] = not liquidity_locked(pool)

    return signals

# OSINT signals (precede on-chain by days/weeks)
def check_osint_signals(project_name):
    signals = {}

    # Social media activity drop
    recent_posts = get_social_activity(project_name, days=7)
    baseline_posts = get_social_activity(project_name, days=30)
    signals['social_silence'] = (len(recent_posts) / max(len(baseline_posts)/4, 1)) < 0.2

    # Telegram/Discord channel status
    signals['channel_deleted'] = not channel_exists(project_name)

    # Developer wallet activity
    dev_wallet = get_deployer_wallet(token_address)
    signals['dev_inactive'] = days_since_last_tx(dev_wallet) > 14

    return signals
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto Rug Pull On-Chain Indicators")`
index=blockchain sourcetype=defi:events
| eval risk_score = case(
    liquidity_removal_pct > 80, 10,
    top5_holder_pct > 0.60, 7,
    has_hidden_mint = "true", 8,
    has_hidden_pause = "true", 6,
    liquidity_unlocked = "true", 5,
    1=1, 0
  )
| where risk_score >= 7
| table _time, token_address, token_name, risk_score,
        liquidity_removal_pct, top5_holder_pct,
        has_hidden_mint, has_hidden_pause, liquidity_unlocked

references: Organized fraud detection in 2026: a technical landscape report — Crypto rug pulls
Mazorra et al., 2022 — Uniswap trading/liquidity feature engineering
Yu & Lee, 2025 — EVM bytecode balance-flow heuristics
Wu et al., 2024 — TokenScout temporal graph learning
falsepositives: Legitimate liquidity rebalancing by project teams
Early-stage tokens with naturally concentrated holdings
